description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a lean, AI-first health and fitness technology team as its first AI and backend engineer. You will build the coaching engine and backend services that power personalized coaching, with end-to-end ownership and close collaboration with the engineering team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own the AI coaching engine, including agents, tool calling, memory, personalization, and guardrails.

 - Develop backend services, data models, APIs, and integrations that support the coaching business.

 - Move prototypes into production with monitoring, evaluations, and controls for cost and latency.

 - Use AI coding tools to plan, implement, and ship software efficiently.

 - Help shape engineering practices and tooling as the team grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on software engineering experience, typically 1 to 10+ years, including backend service development outside research-only settings.

 - Strong Python skills and practical experience building real products with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini.

 - Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code to implement engineering plans and ship software.

 - Early-stage startup, founder, or substantial shipped side-project experience, with strong ownership and comfort working through ambiguity.

 - Firebase or Google Cloud experience and an interest in fitness or health are helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$180,000 annual base salary, plus meaningful equity.


LOCATION

Hybrid in New York City, New York. Candidates open to relocating are welcome.
